observation: The architecture checked the plan against the code and found two things the plan would have shipped broken, and the plan said nothing about either. (1) Every subscription session was told 'Speak only if the subscription's instruction above asks you to' (provisioner.ts:1579), so nine empty prompts would have silenced the assistant for good. (2) A person's DM to the assistant woke it twice, once as a thread turn and once from the thread.message subscription, so every message would get two sessions and two answers. It also woke on its own creation. Both fixes became decisions (D-cetkyt, D-cd6tvw) and were proven: a DM records exactly one intent, and the no-instruction case passed 8/8 on all four harnesses.
